record.one_liner: Vonage provides a suite of communication APIs enabling developers to integrate voice, messaging, and video capabilities using standard webhooks, SDKs, and REST mechanisms.

auth_methods.quote: Vonage APIs support different authentication methods depending on which product you are using: API Key and Secret (Header) JSON Web Token (JWT) ... SIP Trunking uses Digest Authentication method with the API Key as user and API Secret as password.

access_test.quote: Access to our APIs is charged on a per-request basis. We’ll give you some free credit when you first open your account and you can top up when you run low.

api_type.quote: If you are familiar with the command-line tool Curl , you will find Curl snippets for each of our APIs that you can copy, paste and modify.

official_mcp.quote: Welcome to the Vonage API platform! Vonage provides a suite of APIs that enable you to communicate with your customers using your preferred channels.
